content:
My Lean VS Code plugin's server crashed and it wrote a 915GB core dump file at the root of my repository. How to disable these dumps?

P.S. I often experience these crashes when writing meta code.

This is probably more of a Linux question than a Lean question.
What distro are you using?
I'm on NixOS and I was using Lean 4.33.0 when it happened today.

On usual distros changing core_pattern would fix it (and Ubuntu have their own thing going on I think), but on NixOS I guess just google "nixos disable core dumps" and try the settings people recommend
Thanks @Snir Broshi ! I will try changing that from core to /dev/null as suggested here.
